capabilities: Connect the plugin to a Spotify account in settings
Insert a link to the currently playing Spotify song via a command
extras: Spotify approved a Quota Extension on 2024-06-06 making the plugin publicly available; beta testing is offered through BRAT, and support is handled via GitHub issues or email.
motivation: The author built it for people who get inspired to write by music, connecting Spotify to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture what you are listening to on Spotify while writing, so music-inspired writers must look up and paste song links manually.

relations.evidence: a small plugin connecting Spotify to Obsidian.md

summary: Spotify integration that inserts a link to the song currently playing on your Spotify account into the active note.
